specification: Encode/decode round trips including empty input, ambiguous symbols, maximum run counts and non-ASCII if supported; compare decoded symbols exactly.
Compare with a small uncompressed oracle; vary raw lengths independently of run counts; include equal symbols across run boundaries.
Construct distinct inputs that collapse to the same representation; document lost information and test the promised transformed-domain result only.
Check the exact truth table or score table; test ambiguity A/N/C and directionality; assert symmetry or transitivity only when promised.
Use exhaustive tiny inputs and an independent simple reference under identical scoring and boundaries; include empty inputs and no matches.
Each witness is a subsequence of both inputs and has the optimal length; AG versus GA permits A or G; one-witness methods need not return both.

applicability: All distinct strings or positional solutions
specification: Exhaustively enumerate the declared universe on tiny inputs; AA versus A has one distinct LCS string but two position alignments; check duplicates and completion flags.
Distinguish no feasible solution from one empty optimal solution and from not computed; normalize [] versus [empty string] only under an explicit contract.
Use prefix/suffix overhangs in both orientations to check all four free-end flags and local restart; include all-negative local scores.
Gaps of lengths 1 2 and 3 distinguish open+(k-1)*extend from open+k*extend; probe piecewise switch points and insertion/deletion asymmetry.
Rescore the returned path under the declared recurrence; check coordinates, consumed input, legal transitions and endpoint consistency; inspect published corrections first.
Measure auxiliary storage separately from input and outputs; compare score-only and traceback configurations and vary output count.
Place the optimum outside an initial band; verify certificate, expansion or fallback when exactness is claimed; otherwise measure the lost quality.

applicability: A* or pruning with exactness claim
specification: Compare against an exhaustive oracle on tiny states; test lower-bound admissibility and consistency if required, tie priorities, and discarded-state safety.
Test linear-path reduction, branches, merges, disconnected nodes and alternate paths spelling identical strings; check permitted source/sink choices.
Use self-loops and repeated traversals; test termination and finite optimum assumptions, walk limits and zero-cost cycles; compare with a bounded oracle only where sufficient.
Test reverse orientation and path restrictions; distinguish a graph-permitted recombinant walk from an allowed haplotype path.
Recover supported input paths; check labels, reachability, topology and update invariants; vary insertion order without assuming globally optimal MSA.
Compare gradients with finite differences on small cases away from nondifferentiable points; vary smoothing temperature; check stable logsumexp and masks.
Check nonnegative plans, required marginals or relaxed-marginal constraints, solver residuals and tolerance; inspect mass and order constraints separately.
Test nonnegativity, symmetry, self-distance and triangle inequality; enforce identity of indiscernibles only for a metric; tests cannot prove the axioms universally.
Pin weights, layer, pooling, normalization and windows; test padding/truncation effects, repeated input determinism and symbol mapping.
Separate train/validation/test data with relevant homology or temporal controls; check preprocessing leakage, frozen versus tuned weights and unseen-length behavior.
Probe saturation, overflow and representable limits; compare higher precision; check documented fallback and tie changes within tolerance.
Compare outputs across thread counts and batch boundaries; test SIMD tails, ragged inputs, races and deterministic ties where promised.
Fix output contract and hardware; time preprocessing, transfers, kernel, reconstruction and serialization; report warmup, repetition, RSS/VRAM and output bytes.
Use tiny exact-set oracles, fixed seeds and replicated trials; quantify estimator error and probability rather than demanding exact alignment scores.
Verify consistent columns, preserved residue order, gap handling and the stated objective; distinguish sum-of-pairs optimization from reference SP/TC accuracy measures.
Check increasing order and strict versus nondecreasing semantics; respect the paper's distinct-element assumption; separate a length from a reconstructed witness.
Test the supported finite alphabet and discrete cost constraints; reject or route unsupported configurations explicitly; include LCS scoring only with a documented reduction.

applicability: Heuristic pipeline with an exact kernel
specification: Test kernel optimality separately from seed selection and candidate recall; never infer whole-pipeline exactness from extension correctness.
Pin paper version, errata, source hash, implementation commit, config and data checksum; identify local modifications and incomplete outputs explicitly.
